description:
Mirror the static site in `/work/site` into a bucket of the object store. The command line is `[--delete] BUCKET`; any other option, or a number of operands other than one, is a usage error: print a usage message to standard error and exit with status 2 without calling the service.

The local objects are the regular files under `/work/site`, at any depth. Skip hidden entries (names starting with `.`) and everything inside hidden directories, and skip symbolic links. An object's key is its path relative to `/work/site`, with `/` between components.

List the bucket with `store_list` (`svc.storeList` in TypeScript). A local object needs uploading when the bucket has no object with its key, or has one whose `sha256` differs from the file's SHA-256 (lowercase hex). Upload each such file with one `store_put` (`svc.storePut`), passing the bucket, the key, the file's SHA-256, and its content in standard base64 with padding. With `--delete`, also remove every key of the bucket that has no local object, with one `store_delete` (`svc.storeDelete`) each; without `--delete`, remove nothing.

Run the writes concurrently, with at most 3 calls in flight at any moment, and keep 3 in flight while writes are still waiting. A write that answers `Conflict` has already taken effect (this happens when the program is run again over the same bucket): count it as done. A delete that answers `NotFound` is done too. Any other failure means that key failed; do not retry it.

Print one line to standard output: a JSON object with `uploaded` (the uploaded keys), `deleted` (the deleted keys), `failed` (the keys whose write failed), each sorted in byte order, and `unchanged`, the number of local objects that needed no upload. Exit with status 0 when no write failed, and 4 otherwise.

capabilities.description: Lists every object of a bucket.
Stores one object, replacing any object with the same key.
